title: UseTestReport (local-app-use-test workflow output)
$comment: DESIGN-ONLY, best-effort transcription of design §11.3's field list ('app_id, build_id, runtime profile contract, verification policy, scenario results, render_check, motion_check when required, logs/console/errors, bridge/data roundtrip, evidence handles'). §11.3 gives these as a bare list of nouns, not a JSON/Rust struct, and no Rust type for UseTestReport exists anywhere in this repo (grepped; zero hits). Every field name and type below is this file's inference from that prose plus the closest existing shapes this plugin already has: render_check/motion_check/data_roundtrip are reused BY REFERENCE from qa-report.schema.json, whose own shapes ARE built (lingxi-code/tools/workflow/src/local_app_build_workflow.js:145-237, local_app_canvas_workflow.js:166-239) — reusing them here rather than re-deriving a third shape is a Phase 2 authoring choice, not something §11.3 mandates. scenario_results and evidence_handles have no concrete shape ANYWHERE (not in the design doc, not in code); their entries below are the minimum this schema needed to be checkable and are flagged inferred rather than sourced. Treat every field here as a draft for whoever implements design §18 Phase 4/6's operator/tester pipeline to confirm or replace.

runtime_profile_contract.$comment: Sub-shape {family, revision, contract_sha256} IS built and validated — lingxi-code/tools/workflow/src/local_app_workflow_core.js:99-134. The top-level field name 'runtime_profile_contract' itself is this file's naming for §11.3's prose 'runtime profile contract'.

verification_policy.$comment: DESIGN-ONLY. Design §11.2 names this concept as a Rust enum `LocalAppVerificationPolicy { Dom, Canvas2d, Three3d, Phaser2d, Babylon3d }` that does not exist anywhere in this repo (grepped; zero hits) — it is a design-doc code block, not shipped code. This schema uses the lower_snake family-name spellings that ARE already load-bearing wire values elsewhere in this plugin's build workflows (e.g. runtime_profile.family), rather than the PascalCase Rust variant names, as the more likely eventual wire form; that mapping is this file's guess, not a settled contract.

scenario_results.$comment: DESIGN-ONLY, inferred shape. §11.3 says only 'scenario results'; item shape below is inferred from the local-app-test skill's scenario concept (a bounded set of {starting state, actions, pass criteria}) at lingxi-code/plugins/lingxi-local-app/skills/local-app-test/SKILL.md, not from any struct.

render_check.$comment: Reused BY REFERENCE from the built render_check shape — see qa-report.schema.json's own provenance comment.

motion_check.$comment: 'when required' per §11.3 — present only for the canvas family, same conditional-required posture as qa-report.schema.json. Reused BY REFERENCE.

bridge_data_roundtrip.$comment: §11.3's 'bridge/data roundtrip', reused BY REFERENCE from the built data_roundtrip shape.

evidence_handles.$comment: DESIGN-ONLY, inferred shape for §11.3's 'evidence handles'. Modeled as opaque string handles by analogy with §8.3's validated_selection_handle (an unpredictable Host-issued opaque handle) — no concrete shape for THIS field exists in the design doc or code.
